title: In vitro study of the effects of postbiotic mouthwash prototype with cannabis extracts on the reduction of inflammatory cytokine: tumor necrosis factor alpha
core_idea: Evaluate whether a postbiotic mouthwash containing cannabis extracts (CBD) reduces levels of the inflammatory cytokine TNF-α in vitro; seven mouthwash formulations were prepared with CBD concentrations ranging from 0.25% to
